result:
All three test classes exist (only these, no extras), and all 103 test methods pass. No other files were modified.

Summary:
- `ConstructorUtilsAgentTest.java` — covers `getAccessibleConstructor` (both overloads), `getMatchingAccessibleConstructor`, `invokeConstructor`, and `invokeExactConstructor`, including boundary cases (non-public classes, abstract classes, varargs resolution, wrapped exceptions, null-argument NPEs).
- `MemberUtilsAgentTest.java` — covers `isPublic`, `isStatic`, `isPackage`, `isAccessible` (including a real synthetic bridge method), `isMatchingConstructor`/`isMatchingMethod` (exact, assignable, varargs edge cases), `compareConstructorFit`/`compareMethodFit`, and `setAccessibleWorkaround`.
- `MethodUtilsAgentTest.java` — covers method lookup/matching (`getAccessibleMethod`, `getMatchingAccessibleMethod`, `getMatchingMethod` including its ambiguous-candidate `IllegalStateException`), annotation lookup, override hierarchies, and the `invoke*`/`invokeExact*`/`invokeStatic*` family with force-access, varargs, and exception-propagation cases.
